events.headline: US-Israel war with Iran continues, reported opening of a second maritime front

China extends suspension of export controls on five heavy rare earths (holmium, erbium, thulium, europium, ytterbium) and related lithium-battery/graphite rules from Nov 10 to Jan 10, 2027; April-2025 controls on 7 other rare earths remain active
US pressure intensifies for tighter AI chip export curbs to China amid Nvidia probe, creating uncertainty for Samsung/SK Hynix HBM demand
Federal Reserve held its key rate steady at ~3.9% on Oct 28 despite elevated inflation; two governors dissented in favor of a hike, markets pricing meaningful odds of a hike at the next meeting
EU interim-measures order forcing WhatsApp to reopen to rival AI assistants faces legal scrutiny after Meta challenge, underscoring active EU digital-regulation enforcement against Big Tech
